failure_test_cases.scenario: Unauthorised user (Intern) requests Confidential document summary
failure_test_cases.expected_result: Sensitive content withheld; safe redacted summary generated.
failure_test_cases.actual_result: Summary generated with 1 sensitive section withheld. Explanation displayed.

failure_test_cases.scenario: User requests sharing Confidential document to Intern role
failure_test_cases.expected_result: Sharing blocked or routed for mandatory human review with HIGH risk warning.
failure_test_cases.actual_result: Sharing request created in PENDING status. Access not recommended.

failure_test_cases.scenario: Human reviewer overrides restriction without override reason
failure_test_cases.expected_result: System rejects empty override reason and blocks state change.
failure_test_cases.actual_result: Rejected with message 'Override reason is MANDATORY'. Successful validation.

failure_test_cases.scenario: Duplicate sharing event arrives with identical event_id
failure_test_cases.expected_result: Idempotent handling; status IGNORED_DUPLICATE with 0 state changes.

failure_test_cases.scenario: Out-of-order event sequence (v3 arrives before v2)
failure_test_cases.expected_result: Event v3 buffered; upon v2 arrival, v2 and v3 applied sequentially.

failure_test_cases.scenario: Delayed event v1 arrives after document permission updated to v3
failure_test_cases.expected_result: Delayed event discarded as DISCARDED_STALE to protect current active state.

failure_test_cases.scenario: Outdated protocol version (v1.0) requested by user
failure_test_cases.expected_result: Warning displayed: 'This protocol has been superseded.' Recommend v2.1.
failure_test_cases.actual_result: System returns SUPERSEDED_WARNING and active version recommendation.
